I hope u will reply me back inshaa Allah 1496 views Q. Salam Alaikum wrwb! More than a year back my sister saw dream in which I met with an accident and one of my hands was severed. At that time my younger brother got married to a girl with out the knowledge of our family. As this girl does not belong to a good family, she was not accepted in our family. I interpreted this dream of my sister as losing my borther. But few months later I got separated from my wife and despite several attempts it now down to Khula. Kindly let me know the meaning of this dream. Jazakallahu Khair 1468 views Q. Asalamwalakum! i saw a dream this morning that i have many relatives at my house and they are just preparing for some function.i saw i am cooking chappatis in the kitchen on a big tawa. and my small cousin is helping me.he is trying to lit fire to the wood to cook food and tell him not to do so.then i saw i go to bathroom n take bath.then i saw i am going with a very fast speed and beside me one lady with 2 small kids is on one white horse and i felt that she was running from someone and trying to save her kids.on my way ahead i kept seeing many same kind women on white horses running.i later feel may be they are just idols or some picture but as i move on i saw few sikh men trying to learn how to ride a horse and then there is a big gate where that lane ends where they are practising.now i also feel that i was also riding a horse as i was moving with very fast speed!"Please help in understanding this Allah hafiz! 1740 views Q. THIS IS MY SIXTH EMAIL: ---------------------- Assalam U Alikum, Respected Sir, I Got married On August 19 ,2007 in Kashmir & Since I am working in Dubai.I Got my wife to Dubai and accompanied her back to kashmir during her pregnancy ,She delivered a baby on May 07 ,2008.Again after the delivery of Child ,i got her again to Dubai In sept 2008 .She started coughing in december and as usual i took her to Various hospitals and at last when doctors and we decided ,i took her to kashmir for treatment. After quite long treatment she expired on March 04 ,2009. Now & Then my In-Laws started making accusations against me like i am alcoholic , and various such accusations ,which happened to be false. Now i want to Know who is the Custodian of Child & what is the solution for Property. My Mother,Sister are alive and My Mother-In-Law is dead but my Sister in law ,father in law are alive. Please let me know who is the custodian of Child and how property will divide. 1328 views Q. دس سال پہلے میں مسلمان ہواتھا، میرے والدین کا انتقال ہوگیاہے، میرے دوست کے والدین ہی میرا خیال رکھتے تھے، وہ لوگ میرے لیے دلہن تلاش کررہے ہیں، میرے مسلمان ہونے کی وجہ سے بہت ساری لڑکیوں نے مجھے مسترد کردیاہے،میں ان پر الزام نہیں دے رہاہوں، بلکہ مجھے اتفاق ہے کہ ہر ایک کو اپنا شریک حیات چننے کا حق ہے، لیکن میری صورت حال میں سبھی لوگ ایک ہی وجہ بتاتے ہیں۔ ایک اور بات میں شیئر کرنا چاہوں گاکہ پوری دنیا میں اسلام بہت تیزی سے پھیل رہا ہے، ( اللہ کا شکرہے)۔حال ہی میں بی بی سی /سی این این (یقین نہیں ہے، بلکہ سناہے)نے اسلام کا سروے کیا تو اسلام ہی ایک ایسا مذہب ہے جو ہر سال تیزی سے پھیل رہا ہے۔ الحمد للہ۔ میں صرف یہ وجہ جاننا چاہتاہوں کہ کیوں لوگ سمجھتے ہیں کہ سارے نومسلم گناہ گار ہیں؟ اور ان کو مسترد کیا جاتاہے؟ میرا خیال ہے کہ حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے علاوہ سبھی لوگ نومسلم ہیں اور اسلام میں داخل ہوئے ہیں؟اگر میں غلط کہہ رہا ہوں تو صحیح رہنمائی فرمائیں۔ 1338 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 12573 Country: India Title: Assalamalekum Janab, Mera Nam Nadeem Ahmed Khan hai or mai apni family mey sab se barha hu, mai aksar ye Khowab dekha karta tha ke ?Mera guzar ek jangal se ho raha hai or ye jangal ajib see Wehshat pale huye hai, mujhye Khowab mai hi ek ajib sa khof lagta hai, phir mai Sher Dekhta hu, Indian Tiger, dhariyowala, kabhi kabhi Babar Sher bhi dekha hai shayad, ye sher jangal mai edhar se udhar bhag rahe hote hai, ya phi mera guzar ek viran jangal se ho raha hai, kabhi kabhi mai apne bhai or bahano ko bhi apne sath jangal mai dekhta hu, phir dekhta hu k ek sher udhar se guzar raha hai, ya phi wo hamari taraf a raha hai, ya hamari taraf a jayega esa lagta hai, khawab mai hi may khofjada ho jata hu, edhar kuch salo se ye silsila band ho gaya hai, mai aksar ye sochta tha ke es ki tabir kiya hogi, Shayad aap kuch bata sake to mai sukrguzar honga. Answer ID: 12573 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 699/525=L/1430) These dreams seem satanic. Recite Surah the four Quls (Surah Kafiroon, Ikhlas, Falaq and Nass) and Ayatul Kursi and blow on body before going to bed. In-sha-Allah, you will not see such dreams.
